Marjinal sosyal fayda: Or in short MSB: the additional utility that one more unit of a product provides to the whole of society together with the consumer.
Marjinal sosyal maliyet: Or in short MSC: the additional cost borne by the whole of society together with the producer to produce one more unit.
Marjinal tasarruf eğilimi: Or in short MPS: the change seen in the quantity of private saving when total income in an economy increases by one unit.
Marjinal teknik ikame oranı: Or in short MRTS: the amount of one input to be given up in order to use more of another, keeping total product unchanged.
Marjinal özel fayda: Or in short MPB: the additional utility that one more unit of a product provides to the consumer.
Marjinal özel maliyet: Or in short MPC: the additional cost borne by the producer to produce one more unit.
Marjinal ürün: Or in short MP: the additional product brought by using one more unit of a certain production factor.
Marjinal ürün geliri: Or in short MRP: the additional revenue brought by using one more unit of a certain production factor.
Marka Tescil: The registration of any kind of sign, including personal names — words, shapes, colors, letters, numbers, sounds and the form of goods or their packaging — on the condition that it enables an undertaking's goods or services to be distinguished from other undertakings' goods or services, and that it can be shown in the registry in a way that the subject of the protection granted to the trademark owner can be clearly and precisely understood.
Market: Competition envisages a system in which there is no obstacle whatsoever to entry into the market. In other words, in competitive markets there is no obstacle before new undertakings' entering the market, and individuals can carry out any activity they wish within the framework of their own abilities, skills and knowledge. In markets where competition is restricted, however, the undertakings controlling the market, in order not to share their privileged position with others, use methods such as advertising and product differentiation to obstruct entry into the market
Market Power: The power of one or a group of undertakings to raise the price above the level it should be under competitive conditions and thereby to obtain high profits from these actions. In a fully competitive market, the price of a product equals its marginal cost, and undertakings cannot influence the market price. Mektubu: The supporting document, also requested in incentive certificate applications, given by the relevant distribution company to the investments found positive as a result of the evaluation in the production and connection applications of renewable energy investments.
Melek Yatırımcı: Wealthy individuals expressed as a special type of investor who invests at an early stage in the establishment of enterprises containing high risk and high growth potential.
Menkul kıymet: The general name of the financial assets carrying monetary value and that can be bought and sold for investment purposes.
Menkul Kıymet Mutabakat Sistemi: The structure with common rules, offering the infrastructure necessary for the clearing and settlement transactions made with the aim of realizing the securities transfers arising from the transfer orders among three or more participants.
Menü maliyeti: The costs firms incur in order to change the nominal prices of their products.
Menşe: The names defining the products originating from a locality, region or, in exceptional cases, a country with determined geographical boundaries, taking all or the essential part of their characteristics from the natural and human elements specific to this geographical area, and whose production, processing and other operations all take place within the boundaries of this geographical area. Mentorship: the guidance given by a more experienced or more knowledgeable person to a less experienced or less knowledgeable person.
Merkantilizm: The school of thought maintaining that wealth is determined by the amount of valuable minerals owned, and that commercial relations are fundamentally a zero-sum game.
Merkez bankası: The public organization undertaking the duty of managing the monetary system of one or more countries.
Merkez Bankası Araç Bağımsızlığı: Means the central bank's being able to freely choose, without needing the approval of the government or another authority, the monetary policy instruments and methods it will use to reach its final aim set by law, and its being able to use these instruments freely. For central banks, independence mostly expresses instrument independence.
Merkez Bankası Bağımsızlığı: The capacity of the monetary authorities to take their institutional, administrative, financial and monetary policy-related decisions independently of any element of pressure.
Merkez Bankası Müdahalesi: The making of purchases and sales by central banks in the markets, directed toward realizing their short- and long-term monetary policy aims. With the intervention, the aim is to lower/raise the market prices of the variables intervened in, such as exchange rates and interest, to the levels foreseen in the policy. Intervention methods can differ. Central banks can intervene directly and openly by being counterparty and showing themselves, or they can intervene indirectly. Similarly, central bank interventions can be announced in advance in terms of time and amount, or can be carried out without any announcement. The situations requiring intervention take shape within the framework of the monetary policy aims being implemented.
Merkezi Karşı Taraf - MKT: The organization undertaking the completion of transactions by assuming the role of buyer against seller and seller against buyer among the parties of the financial contracts traded in one or more markets.
Merkezi Kayıt Kuruluşu - MKK: The central registration and depository institution operating to carry out the transactions relating to the book-entry registration of capital market instruments, to track by book entry, electronically, these registered instruments and the rights attached to them by members and rights holders, and to carry out their central depository. At present, the share certificates of the companies whose shares trade on Borsa Istanbul, exchange-traded funds, investment funds, government domestic debt securities, private sector debt instruments, asset-backed securities and lease certificates are tracked by book entry by MKK. The clearing and settlement of the purchase and sale transactions relating to those of the said capital market instruments tracked by book entry at MKK that trade on Borsa Istanbul is carried out through the integrated system between MKK and Takasbank. The settlement of the said transactions realized on Borsa Istanbul is completed when the transfer of the securities in the investors' accounts at MKK takes place, in line with the customer-based netted transaction results received from Takasbank. Within this scope, for the untroubled realization of the clearing and settlement of the purchase and sale transactions of the said capital market instruments traded on Borsa Istanbul, the MKK system must operate in coordination with Takasbank's system.
Merkezi planlamalı ekonomi: The economic system in a country in which the state decides what to produce, how, and for whom.
Merkezi Saklama Kuruluşu: The institutions possessing private-law legal personality in the form of joint-stock companies that provide the services of the central depository of capital market instruments and the exercise of the rights relating to them.
Merkezi Yönetim Bütçe Dengesi: The budget balance found by subtracting budget expenditures from the total of the budget revenues of the general budget administrations, special budget administrations and regulatory and supervisory institutions within the scope of central government.
Merkezi Yönetim Bütçesi: The main budget heading consisting of three sections: the General Budget, the Special Budget, and the Regulatory and Supervisory Institutions Budget.
Merkezi Yönetim Faiz Dışı Bütçe Dengesi: The budget balance found by subtracting the non-interest budget expenditures from the total of the budget revenues of the general budget administrations, special budget administrations and regulatory and supervisory institutions within the scope of central government.
Merkezi Yönetim Riski: Refers to the risk an investor is exposed to because of lending to a country other than the one where it is resident, or lending to an institution/organization guaranteed by the government of the said country. Risks such as the reduction of the value of foreign-currency liabilities by the alteration of exchange rate regulations by the central bank or competent authority of the country invested in, or the non-realization of direct debt or interest payments, constitute sovereign risk.
Mevduat bankası: The institutions that collect deposits in return for interest, extend credits, and offer various financial services.
Mevduat oranı: The interest rate banks give in return for the deposits they collect.
Mevsim ve Takvim Etkisinden Arındırma: The periodic movements repeating in the same periods of every year can be called seasonality. The calendar effect, on the other hand, includes the movements that can form due to effects such as the change in the number of working days in a period. In order to better evaluate the tendencies in the data and to compare consecutive periods, series are adjusted for seasonality and calendar effects by statistical methods.
Mikro İşletme: The enterprises employing fewer than ten annual employees and whose annual net sales revenue or financial balance sheet, whichever applies, does not exceed three million Turkish liras.
Mikroekonomi: The main branch of economics that takes the decision-makers in the economy individually and examines their behavior.
Mikrofinans: The small-scale banking and insurance services provided to persons having difficulty accessing the traditional financial system.
Mikrokredi: The credits given for low-income individuals and, particularly, women to engage in a production activity that will sustain themselves.
Miktar kısıtlaması: The market intervention the state implements by determining the quantity supplied for a product.
Milli gelir hesaplaması: The general name of the methods such as gross domestic product, gross national product, net national product, personal income and disposable personal income, used to track total production and total income in the economy.
Milli gelir hesaplamasının temel denkliğ: The fact that the market value of total production in a country, the total expenditure made to purchase these products, and the total income arising from sales equal one another.
Minimum Efficient Scale: The minimum efficient scale is the smallest scale at which average costs are minimized. This concept carries importance for understanding market structure. For example, in the case where the minimum efficient scale is smaller compared to the general size of the market, a greater number of firms is expected to be found in the market, and hence the market is expected to have a competitive structure.
Model: The whole of the mathematical definitions and relationships serving to describe and predict an economic phenomenon or behavior by simplifying it to a certain extent.
Model Fabrika: The training applications specially designed — and the physical environments where these applications will be offered — to develop the application-oriented skills of enterprises, through learning by doing in experimental settings, on matters such as lean production, process improvement, product development and problem solving, within the scope of the efficiency increase and digitalization required for global competition in enterprises, and to transform firms by quickly putting these new skills into practice.
Modern miktar kuramı: The body of principles maintaining that, under the assumption of the stability of the velocity of money's circulation, there is a same-directional and proportional relationship between the money supply and the general price level.
Modernizasyon Yatırımı: Refers to the investments including the addition of parts suited to the machinery and equipment that have completed their technical and/or economic life in the production lines of existing facilities, or the replacement of existing machinery and equipment with new ones, the completion of the sections left incomplete in the facility, the direct raising of the quality of the final product or the changing of its model.
Modifiye süresi: The sensitivity measure, found by dividing the Macaulay duration by (1+y), giving the percentage effect on the price of a one-unit change in interest: ΔP ≈ −D*·Δy.
Money Laundering and Terrorist: Financing. IBAN (International Bank Account Number): the International Bank Account Number providing the standard for the automatic holding and validity of bank account numbers. IBAN, developed by ECBS (European Committee for Banking Standards), is a series of alphanumeric characters identifying an account held at a bank anywhere in the world. Having at most 34 characters, IBAN contains the ISO, the country code, two check digits and the bank account number. Processed and stored electronically
Monopol: A monopoly is the situation in which there is a single seller in the market. The demand curve facing the monopolist is negatively sloped. The comparison of the outcomes of the monopoly and fully competitive markets shows that the monopolist sets a higher price, produces less, and earns more than economic profit (monopoly rent). In this case, consumers face a high price in a way that causes a loss of welfare, and income flows from consumers to the monopolist undertaking
Monopson: A market structure in which a product supplied by more than one seller is demanded by a single buyer, and obstacles lie before the entry of other buyers into the market.
Moratoryum: A debtor's declaring that it will be unable to pay all or a part of its debts owing to losing its ability to pay. It generally results in the restructuring of the debt between the debtor and the creditor.
